name: generate_image
description: Generate AI images via Cloudflare (FLUX, free daily), Puter (GPT Image/Gemini/Imagen, 1000 monthly credits), Pollinations (unlimited, flaky), Perchance (SDXL, free), DreamForge (Perchance-based, advanced controls), or Advanced SDXL (Perchance-based, model/composition control). Auto-fallback if provider not specified.

provider.description: Which provider to use. 'auto' tries Cloudflare → Pollinations → Perchance. 'dreamforge' uses Perchance with art-style/quality/lighting/atmosphere controls. 'advanced-sdxl' uses Perchance with model-type/composition/style preset controls. Default: auto

model.description: Model ID. Cloudflare: @cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell (default), @cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-dev, @cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b, @cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-9b, @cf/lykon/dreamshaper-8-lcm, @cf/stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0. Puter: openai/gpt-image-1-mini (default), openai/gpt-image-2, openai/gpt-image-1.5, openai/gpt-image-1. Pollinations: flux, turbo. Ignored for Perchance.

style.description: Art style preset. Best 11: painted_anime, cyberpunk, oil_painting, ghibli, cinematic, fantasy, photorealistic, pixel_art, watercolor, horror, surreal. Also accepts free-text (e.g. 'in the style of Moebius'). Prepended as prompt prefix. Default: no_style

count.description: Number of images to generate (1-4). Perchance, DreamForge, and Advanced SDXL support native batch; other providers generate one at a time. Default: 1

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the image. Supported by all providers. Default: low-quality, deformed, blurry, bad art

seed.description: Seed for reproducibility (-1 for random). Supported by all providers.
